description: This file defines a Tiptap extension for handling text direction (RTL) in a rich text editor, including functions to get and set text direction, and configuration of global attributes for various content types.

classes.name: TextDirection
classes.description: A Tiptap extension that manages text direction attributes for various content types, allowing setting and parsing of 'rtl' direction.

methods.name: getTextDirection
methods.description: Retrieves the text direction ('rtl' or undefined) for the current selection in the editor.
